name: qa-unit-tests-jvm
description: JVM unit testing: 1 umbrella skill (jvm-unit-tests) covering JUnit 5 as the primary framework (configure / run / parameterize / coverage / CI), a per-language framework decision table (Java → JUnit 5, Kotlin → Kotest, Groovy → Spock, Scala → ScalaTest, legacy → TestNG), and test-authoring conventions, with Kotest, Spock, TestNG, ScalaTest, and AssertJ as references.
